changelog:
v3.3.3 — AC3/EAC3 Audio Fix for Fire TV Stick

• FFmpeg audio fallback: auto-rebuilds player with FFmpeg-preferred mode when hardware falsely claims AC3/EAC3 support (fixes mt8695 Fire TV Sticks)
• Fixed onTracksChanged re-enabling audio after Stage 2 disabled it — root cause of infinite crash loop on AC3/EAC3-only streams
• Broadened audio error detection to catch MediaCodecAudioRenderer errors by message text
• Three-stage audio recovery: alternate track → FFmpeg rebuild → disable audio (was two-stage)
• Player listener preserved across FFmpeg rebuild — error handling, track changes, state all survive
